scope: Independent archived native Viewer profile audit; not primary CPU timing or performance qualification.
limitations: Exclusive sampled weights are diagnostic; no primary callback quantiles, CPU cycles, GPU timing or FPS are inferred.
Endpoint counters bracket CDP start/stop and are wider than the exact profile interval; profiler/observer overhead is uncalibrated.
Fixed oracles establish finite equality, while natural playback is not frame-matched across routes.
Source-map exact positions and source-byte/provenance chains are independently checked. AST function owner/name selection and semantic bucket classification are not independently re-parsed.
PNG bytes/dimensions and preserved GPU pixel hashes are checked; this verifier does not recreate WebGL pixel readback.
Missing or failed capture evidence stays explicitly incomplete; additional devices/days and primary adoption gates are not supplied.
